systems.purpose: Canonical terminology, definitions, aliases, glossaries, dictionaries, indexes, FAQs, naming governance, trademark-use ledger, semantic reconciliation, language continuity, and governed candidate discovery.
systems.authority_boundary: Records language and mark-use evidence; it does not create ownership, trademark registration, licensing, legal authority, or publication authority.

five_stage.discover: Ingest candidate terms, aliases, definitions, mark-use evidence, FAQ demand, and drift.
five_stage.govern: Resolve canonical identity, ownership/authority source, sensitivity, legal-status evidence, CIE semantics, and deprecation rules.
five_stage.execute: Compile governed registries, glossaries, dictionaries, indexes, FAQ indexes, alias maps, trademark-use ledgers, and production evidence bundles.
five_stage.verify: Detect collisions, unknown aliases, illegal registered-mark symbols, missing provenance, downstream vocabulary drift, and runtime receipt integrity.
five_stage.preserve: Version terms, provenance, aliases, deprecations, mark-use evidence, generated language packs, discoveries, and run receipts.

systems.purpose: Governed marketing planning, messaging, campaign manifests, channel routing, terminology conformance, CTA packaging, bounded artifact dispatch, and measurement handoff across CrownThrive.
systems.authority_boundary: May plan, validate, queue, and package marketing only within PentaScribe/CIE/CHLOM constraints; it cannot self-authorize provider publication, paid spend, claims, rights, or economic actions.

five_stage.discover: Resolve objective, audience, offer, corridor, channels, vocabulary, imprint, evidence, and measurement targets.
five_stage.govern: Validate terminology, claims, CIE imprint, CHLOM authority, rights, spend, channel, adapter, and approval boundaries.
five_stage.execute: Compile campaign/message manifests, queue work, emit bounded artifacts, and hand off only to certified distribution, media, commerce, and documentation lanes.
five_stage.verify: Check canonical terminology, adapter state, publication receipts when available, channel state, analytics bindings, and outcome measurement.
five_stage.preserve: Retain campaign versions, term-registry version, assets, approvals, queue states, receipts, metrics, and retrospectives.
